instruction: DevOps & Cloud topshirig'i #1: GitHub Actions: Testlash, Docker Tasvirini Yig'ish va Docker Hub-ga Yuklash
input: Har safar 'main' tarmog'iga kod yuborilganda (push) avtomatik testlarni o'tkazib, Docker tasvirini yig'ib Docker Hub-ga yuklovchi to'liq GitHub Actions workflow faylini tuzing.
output:
### Yechim va Konfiguratsiya:
```yaml
name: Build and Push Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test_and_deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Kodni yuklab olish (Checkout)
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Python muhitini sozlash
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Bog'liqliklarni o'rnatish va Testlarni yurgazish
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt pytest
        pytest tests/

    - name: Docker Buildx sozlash
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

    - name: Docker Hub-ga kirish
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Tasvirni yig'ish va yuklash (Build & Push)
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        push: true
        tags: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/khorazmiy-api:latest,${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/khorazmiy-api:${{ github.sha }}
        cache-from: type=gha
        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```

### Muhandislik tushuntirishi:
1. `secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN` orqali parollar havfsiz saqlanadi va loglarda ko'rinmaydi.
2. `cache-from: type=gha` GitHub Actions keshidan foydalanib yig'ish vaqtini bir necha barobar qisqartiradi.
3. Har bir commit SHA tegi bilan belgilanadi, bu istalgan vaqtda eski versiyaga qaytish (rollback) imkonini beradi.

### Ishga tushirish va tekshirish:
```bash
git push origin main
# GitHub Actions tabida jarayonni kuzatish
```

instruction: DevOps & Cloud topshirig'i #3: Ansible Playbook: NGINX va Node.js serverlarini avtomatlashtirilgan o'rnatish
input: Barcha serverlarga Nginx va Node.js o'rnatuvchi, konfiguratsiyani nusxalovchi va xizmatni qayta ishga tushiruvchi Ansible Playbook tuzing.
output:
### Yechim va Konfiguratsiya:
```yaml
---
- name: Web Serverlarni Sozlash
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  vars:
    node_version: "20.x"

  tasks:
    - name: Paket indekslarini yangilash
      apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600

    - name: Zarur tizim utilitalarini o'rnatish
      apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ufw
          - git
          - nginx
        state: present

    - name: NodeSource omborini qo'shish va Node.js o'rnatish
      shell: |
        curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_{{ node_version }} | bash -
        apt-get install -y nodejs
      args:
        creates: /usr/bin/node

    - name: Maxsus Nginx konfiguratsiyasini yuklash
      template:
        src: templates/nginx.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/default
      notify: Nginxni qayta yuklash

    - name: Nginx xizmati yoqilganligini ta'minlash
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: yes

  handlers:
    - name: Nginxni qayta yuklash
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded
```

### Muhandislik tushuntirishi:
1. `become: yes` vazifalarni sudo huquqida bajarishni ta'minlaydi.
2. `creates: /usr/bin/node` idempotentlik tamoyiliga ko'ra dastur allaqachon mavjud bo'lsa qayta ishlamaydi.
3. `notify` va `handlers` konfiguratsiya fayli o'zgargandagina Nginx ni qayta yuklaydi.

### Ishga tushirish va tekshirish:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini setup_web.yml
```

instruction: DevOps & Cloud topshirig'i #4: Prometheus va Node Exporter Monitoring sozlamalari

global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "prometheus_master"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]

  - job_name: "production_linux_nodes"
    scrape_interval: 10s
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - "node1.khorazmiy.uz:9100"
          - "node2.khorazmiy.uz:9100"

instruction: DevOps & Cloud topshirig'i #6: GitLab CI/CD: Multi-stage Pipeline (.gitlab-ci.yml)
input: GitLab loyihasida yig'ish (build), birlik testlar (unit-test) va staging serverga avtomatik tarqatish (deploy) bosqichlarini o'z ichiga olgan pipeline yozing.
output:
### Yechim va Konfiguratsiya:
```yaml
stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy

variables:
  DOCKER_DRIVER: overlay2

compile_code:
  stage: build
  image: golang:1.22
  script:
    - go mod download
    - go build -o bin/app .
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - bin/app
    expire_in: 1 day

run_tests:
  stage: test
  image: golang:1.22
  script:
    - go test -v -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
  coverage: '/coverage: \d+.\d+% of statements/'

deploy_to_staging:
  stage: deploy
  image: alpine:latest
  before_script:
    - apk add --no-cache openssh-client
    - eval $(ssh-agent -s)
    - echo "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" | tr -d '' | ssh-add -
  script:
    - scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no bin/app deployer@staging.khorazmiy.uz:/opt/app/app_new
    - ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no deployer@staging.khorazmiy.uz "sudo systemctl restart khorazmiy_app"
  only:
    - main
```

### Muhandislik tushuntirishi:
1. `artifacts` build bosqichida yaratilgan binar faylni keyingi deploy bosqichiga xavfsiz o'tkazadi.
2. `coverage` test qamrovi foizini GitLab interfeysida ko'rsatib turadi.
3. `only: main` faqat asosiy tarmoqqa qilingan o'zgarishlar staging serverga chiqarilishini belgilaydi.

### Ishga tushirish va tekshirish:
```bash
git push origin main
# GitLab CI/CD > Pipelines oynasida kuzatish
```
